volunteer.title: Volunteering
volunteer.lead: PLONK is run by its own people. Like Telegram communities: support is answered not by staff but by those who care. If you have an hour or two a week — join us.
volunteer.what_answer_text: Help people whose photo won't upload, whose code doesn't arrive or who can't figure out how to renew a listing.
volunteer.what_moderate_text: Let the honest ones through, stop suspicious ones — before anyone sends money.
volunteer.what_rules_text: A team badge in your profile and our gratitude. No pay — we say it straight.
volunteer.in_team: You're already on the team. Thank you!
volunteer.pending: Application sent — we'll reply within a couple of days, you'll get a notification.
volunteer.decided_accepted: Accepted — you're on the team. "Support requests" and "Moderation" are now in your profile.
volunteer.decided_rejected: Not this time. You can apply again in a month.
volunteer.about: Who you are, what you do, why you want to help. A couple of sentences is enough.
volunteer.too_short: Tell us a bit more — at least a couple of sentences.
volunteer.note_placeholder: A few words for the applicant (optional)
